dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Trailing edge displays a concave spline curvature extending from the posterior insertion point to the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Acute shape classification with a minimal pixel radius, creating a sharp point at the highest morphological extent.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Steep linear margin measured at approximately 55-60 degrees relative to the horizontal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Maximum base width is approximately 1.4 times the maximum vertical height.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Smooth, large-radius convex arc defining the melon boundary from the blowhole area to the rostrum.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Extremely short and blunt rostrum with a minimal length-to-thickness pixel ratio.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Shallow obtuse angle of approximately 165 degrees at the pixel transition between the melon and the rostrum.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Visible irregularly shaped light-colored patch on the dorsal ridge immediately anterior to the dorsal fin; small punctate markings on the lateral flank.
other_distinctive_markers: Dark pigmented patch surrounding the ocular region and a distinct pectoral fin with a convex leading edge.
